caption: The drawing features a single wooden table with a reddish-brown color, positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The tabletop has a unique shape with a scalloped or clover-like back edge, creating a three-lobed outline, and the edge of the table appears to be slightly ridged or accented. The table stands on a single, ornately carved central pedestal that transitions into three outward-curving legs, each ending in a small green caster or wheel. The shading and coloring highlight the wood grain and carved details, particularly on the pedestal and legs. The name "Bernard Krieger" is written in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Table Pedestal
